name: Kindaichi Hajime
source:
Attends Fudou High School. Despite poor grades, a tendency to cut class, and habitual tardiness, he is  a detective with an IQ of 180. Also the Grandson of Kindaichi Kousuke.

Taken from the game's character profile.
